hints.title: Two-Dimensional Prefix Formula
hints.text: The prefix value for cell (r, c) equals val[r-1][c] ^ val[r][c-1] ^ val[r-1][c-1] ^ matrix[r][c].

hints.title: Compute All Cell Values
hints.text: Fill the prefix table row by row, gathering all m * n computed values.

hints.title: Find Kth Largest Value
hints.text: Sort the collected values in descending order and select the element at index k - 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing subgrid XOR naively for each cell takes O(m^2 * n^2) quartic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2D prefix DP evaluates all coordinate values in O(m * n) time and sorts in O(m * n log(m * n)).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies 2D inclusion-exclusion using bitwise XOR cancellation.
